NBA-LAL-at-DET-1108.summary: Detroit is without Jalen Duren (hamstring, at least two weeks) and Isaiah Joe, so Paul Reed starts at center and John Collins may play some center in smaller lineups. I could not find a current report on Luka Doncic's back; he is listed questionable in the packet.

NFL-CIN-at-ATL-1108.summary: Played in Madrid. Atlanta is again without backup RB Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring), leaving Bijan Robinson as the clear lead back, and WR Zachariah Branch is out, with Olamide Zaccheaus expected to take the slot snaps. Cincinnati is missing TE Erick All (IR, ACL), WR Andrei Iosivas (IR) and S Kyle Dugger; Burrow has no designation.

NFL-DAL-at-IND-1108.summary: Dallas has George Pickens (hamstring, limited all week) and Jake Ferguson (ankle, missed Wednesday and Thursday) questionable, and KaVontae Turpin out again; their status decides how targets spread behind CeeDee Lamb. No new Colts news was found beyond the packet's report.

NFL-DEN-at-CAR-1108.summary: Carolina's line is banged up: G Damien Lewis is out and OL Corey Bullock, Brady Christensen and Torricelli Simpkins III are questionable; the Panthers also lose LBs Jaelan Phillips and Bobby Okereke and CB Will Lee III. Denver WR Pat Bryant practiced fully all week; S Talanoa Hufanga is questionable. Denver's backfield is a three-way split since Jonah Coleman returned from IR.

NFL-DET-at-MIA-1108.summary: Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) was limited all week and listed questionable, but a Sunday-morning report says he will play. Detroit's defense is thin: LB Jack Campbell, CB D.J. Reed, S Kerby Joseph and EDGE DJ Wonnum are out, plus starting C Cade Mays; both backup RBs (Saylors, Vaki) are questionable. Miami's Kaytron Allen and Jaylen Wright are questionable behind Ollie Gordon II; De'Von Achane is on IR for the season.

NFL-GB-at-NE-1108.summary: New England is without RB TreVeyon Henderson (illness) for a second straight week, so Rhamondre Stevenson leads the backfield with Corey Kiner as depth; A.J. Brown (knee) is also out, Hunter Henry is questionable (foot) and Mack Hollins was activated from IR but is questionable. Green Bay is missing Micah Parsons plus OL Sean Rhyan and Travis Glover, and RB MarShawn Lloyd was added to the report Thursday with a knee issue.

NFL-HOU-at-LAC-1108.summary: Houston is again without David Montgomery (groin), so Woody Marks stays the lead back, and S Reed Blankenship is out. The Chargers list TE David Njoku, WR Brenen Thompson, G Kayode Awosika and LB Denzel Perryman as doubtful, with DB Deane Leonard and S Kendall Williamson out.

NFL-LV-at-SF-1108.summary: San Francisco is without WRs Mike Evans (Achilles tendinitis), Deebo Samuel (hamstring) and Christian Kirk (knee, meniscus), with Brandon Aiyuk also out, so Kittle and McCaffrey carry the passing game; McCaffrey was cleared after a mild hamstring strain and Nick Bosa returns. Demarcus Robinson is questionable coming off IR. Las Vegas is missing DT Thomas Booker; CB Darien Porter is questionable with limited snaps expected.

NFL-NYG-at-PHI-1108.summary: Philadelphia starts Joe Milton III in his first NFL start in place of Tanner McKee (Hurts is out for the season), without WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks and CBs Jonathan Jones and Michael Carter II. Saquon Barkley has no designation after a DNP-limited-limited week. The Giants come off a bye with Tyrone Tracy Jr. on IR and Cam Skattebo doubtful, leaving Devin Singletary to lead the backfield.

NFL-NYJ-at-KC-1108.summary: Jets play without WR Garrett Wilson (concussion), so Isaiah Williams moves to WR1 and Mitchell, Cooper and Mason Taylor split his targets. Breece Hall returns from a five-game quad absence with no game designation, and the coach says both he and Braelon Allen will play, with no split announced. The Jets defense is also missing LB Trevin Wallace, DE Joseph Ossai and CB Nahshon Wright.

NFL-TB-at-CHI-1109.summary: Team sources list this as Sunday night, Nov. 8 (not Monday). Chicago RB Kyle Monangai (toe/thumb) practiced on a limited basis for the first time since Week 4 and is questionable, which could trim D'Andre Swift's and Roschon Johnson's work; CBs Tyrique Stevenson and Malik Muhammad II are questionable. Tampa Bay's Emeka Egbuka (foot) practiced fully Thursday and Friday and is expected back; OLB Yaya Diaby is out and LT Tristan Wirfs has no designation. Gusts near 27 mph are forecast at Soldier Field.

SOCCER-day.summary: No listed player found ruled out except Lyon's Nuamah, who shows up as absent (reason not given) on one injury list. Real Sociedad and Celtic both played Europa League three days ago, so rotation is likely. Palace and Brighton are missing several attackers. Barcelona are without Rodri and Olmo.

NBA-NY-at-CLE-1108.summary: Josh Hart (right ankle soreness) misses a second straight game; Landry Shamet started in his spot Wednesday. Cleveland is on the second night of a back-to-back and is without Jarrett Allen, Sam Merrill, Jaylon Tyson and Nae'Qwan Tomlin. Knicks are 4.5-point road favorites, total 224.5.

NBA-ORL-at-GS-1108.summary: Warriors (6-3, six straight wins) list Draymond Green (elbow), Gary Payton II (calf) and Gui Santos (knee tendinitis, practiced Friday) as questionable; Porzingis has stepped away from the team. Orlando is short-handed with Banchero, Suggs, Isaac, Penda and Nelson all out.

NFL-ARI-at-SEA-1108.summary: Both teams are on backup-level QBs: Seattle starts Drew Lock (elbow still recovering) for Sam Darnold (quad, week-to-week), and Arizona has benched and traded Jacoby Brissett, making Gardner Minshew the starter. Seattle is also missing LT Charles Cross, G Quenton Nelson and WR Rashid Shaheed; Arizona is without RB Bam Knight (concussion) and two starting linemen, leaving Tyler Allgeier as the lead back.

NFL-LA-at-WAS-1108.summary: Washington lost RB Jeremy McNichols and starting DTs Daron Payne and Javon Kinlaw to IR this week and has ruled out WRs Treylon Burks and Dyami Brown. Stafford is on the report with right elbow soreness but says he has practiced fully; he has not topped 33 attempts in three games. Rams CBs McDuffie and Curl missed practice and are questionable.

NFL-CLE-at-NO-1108.summary: Deshaun Watson entered the concussion protocol Tuesday and missed practice through Thursday, so Shedeur Sanders took first-team reps and is expected to make his first start of the season; the line moved from Browns +2.5 to +3. Cleveland pass catchers Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) and Denzel Boston (calf) have been limited, and Alvin Kamara (back) returned to practice Thursday after missing Wednesday.
